full_details: At the post by the Bull the Rose had a new black-letter title, Barnardo and Fiammetta. Phillips had it from Raye: two lovers and a jealous old husband, and Italian sleeves. You laughed, left the road to the other house, and went back to the desk. You never heard a sum. At dinner the loaf was two fingers and more short of the notch, and you called it a married couple who cannot agree. Evening prayer kept Simon and Jude to the prayer. At night the friar's letter has miscarried, and you did not open the tomb. On Field's Rochelle paper you wrote a queen of no country, ruled no head, and left the questions in the margin unanswered.
one_sentence: You read an Italian title at the Bull, ate a short loaf at noon, and by candle wrote one page.
title: Read the Rose title and went back to the desk
